name: wp-theme-studio
description: Authorized studio to generate WordPress themes, pages, CF7 forms, and images

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:vercel: npm run env:vercel && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && node scripts/copy-vercel-public.js
